_meta.description: Middle third of the demo video: how to use the site. Narration and shots for tools/demo/record.mjs --segments tools/demo/segments-middle.json

segments.caption: Explore · 20 committees · 451 members
segments.text: Open OWL and you land on the Explore map. Each coloured dot on the ring is a House committee. The small dots are all 451 members, placed near the committee they work on most.

segments.caption: Line = attention, not agreement
segments.text: Click a committee and it opens into its topics. The lines show attention: who acts on what, and how recently.

segments.caption: Real bills as plain yes-or-no questions
segments.text: Click a topic, and its real bills appear as plain yes-or-no questions.

segments.caption: Answer what you care about
segments.text: Answer the ones you care about. Every answer is checked against what each member actually did on that bill.

segments.caption: Your closest members · filter by state
segments.text: Open your matches to see who is closest to you, and exactly which bills they agree or disagree with you on. Narrow it to your own state.

segments.caption: Every sentence cites a quote
segments.text: Click any member for their profile. The summary is written by Muse Spark, and every sentence cites a statement. Click a number to read the exact quote and its source.

segments.caption: See when a position changed
segments.text: The timeline shows everything they said and voted, and marks the moment a position changed.

segments.caption: Every bill: what it does, who stands where
segments.text: Every bill has its own page: what it does in plain words, where members stand today, and the same question for you to answer.

segments.caption: Search by name, district or ZIP
segments.text: Or just type a name, a district, or your ZIP code at the top, and go straight to your own representative.
